title: Rational Cyano Functionalization of Copper Phenylacetylide Paves the Way for Superior Photogenerated Electron Transport Capability and Diclofenac Degradation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00654F, Paper
Lingrong Chen, Yishun Wang, Fengyuan Zhang, Yanfang Wang, Yunshuang He, Hongda Zhan, Xiaoyu Zhang, Ping Chen, Zili Lin, Wenying Lv, Guoguang Liu
Photocatalytic technology is a promising solution for effectively removing diclofenac (DCF) from wastewater. Herein, we report the theoretical design and solvothermal synthesis of a cyano-modified copper phenylacetylide (PhC2Cu) photocatalyst (Cy-PhC2Cu),...
